lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Speckled BandNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 33THE SPECKLED BAND: A SAUCER OF MILKDr Grimesby Roylott dies of his own snake, in his own chair, and the saucer of milk on the safe is the one detail that the coroner cannot explain. You explain it to nobody. The snake, you remember, could not hear and could not see, and was taught to climb a rope by a whistle. It was an ingenious murder, and a bad idea. He is remembered as the world prefers to remember him: sharp, odd, brilliant and a little aloof.
